schedule.title: Welcome Drinks
schedule.description: Join in for a mingle, light bites, and a first toast to the evening ahead. We can't wait to welcome you!

schedule.title: Ceremony
schedule.description: We invite you to gather with us as we exchange vows surrounded by those we love most. Please arrive a few minutes early so you can settle in before we begin.

schedule.title: Photography
schedule.description: We will be taking photos after the ceremony. Feel free to join us when we are ready. In the meantime, there will be snacks and drinks.

schedule.title: Reception
schedule.description: Let's eat, drink and be merry!

schedule.title: Party
schedule.description: The celebration continues with music, dancing and drinks! We hope you'll stay late and dance with us <3
